title: Rebase, merge, and bounce steering
summary: Decision-ready attribution analysis of the current hybrid: fresh agent delivery rounds rebase onto the current integration line and record a new fenced subject, while server integration preserves the reviewed Result SHA through merge-first admission and permits replay only with transactional one-to-one replacement attribution. Compares delivery and integration strategies against ancestry evidence, card-scoped review, truthful history, exact candidate-SHA promotion, and the pending Batch Gate design. Recommends one deterministic platform bounce, one evidence-reading guardian round only for a repeated or complex conflict, and then Human Review.
